'''2012 Bespin Regionals John Anderson DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
